errors.text_span: 图表共包含16个切片
errors.evidence: The figure shows 19 slices/categories, not 16.

errors.text_span: “司法”类别占比14.57%
errors.evidence: The slice labeled 司法 is 14.57%, but the description places it among the set of 16 slices and omits that there are additional categories; this is part of a broader incorrect count/representation issue. However the numeric value itself matches the chart.

errors.text_span: “社交”类别占比15.44%

errors.text_span: “帮助”类别占比2.93%

errors.text_span: “际遇”类别占比0.27%

errors.text_span: 从视觉上看，切片按其百分比大小从大到小逆时针排列
